notes: Predicts loops for e.g. 0011 -> 11100000, which terminates from every start 0^a 1^b (a <= 6, b <= 8) and every word of length <= 12 (finite reachable sets), and has no loop within the search bounds. Superseded by H-C03-4; not refuted by proof because termination of 0011 -> 11100000 is unproven.
statement: The rule is non-terminating iff r > q, s > p and (r >= 2q or s >= 2p).
title: H-C03-3: non-terminating iff both counts grow and (r >= 2q or s >= 2p) (inconclusive, evidence against)
